name: The voice message
truth: A cloned voice. The AI checker that said “97% authentic” was simply wrong, and it was the most convincing thing anyone posted all week.
tell: asking where she was — she was somewhere else, with people who saw her
volunteer: i was at mia's nan's tonight until ten. her whole family saw me.
